request.style: English, solemn piano ballad, deep tender male vocal, piano, cello, sustained strings, sparse and reverent, swelling on the chorus, 64 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
He grew up like a tender shoot
A root in thirsty ground
No beauty there to hold our eyes
No glory to be found
He was despised and rejected by men
A man of sorrows, acquainted with grief

[Chorus]
But he was pierced for our transgressions
Crushed for our iniquities
The punishment that brought us peace was laid upon him
And by his wounds we are healed

[Verse]
We hid our faces when he passed
We thought that God had struck him down
We never knew the weight he bore
Was ours and not his own
Yet it was our griefs he bore
Our sorrows he carried

[Chorus]
But he was pierced for our transgressions
Crushed for our iniquities
The punishment that brought us peace was laid upon him
And by his wounds we are healed

[Bridge]
All of us have strayed like sheep
Each one has turned to his own way
And the LORD has laid on him
The iniquity of us all
Like a lamb led to the slaughter
He did not open his mouth

[Chorus]
But he was pierced for our transgressions
Crushed for our iniquities
The punishment that brought us peace was laid upon him
And by his wounds we are healed

[Outro]
By his wounds we are healed
